content.text: Check covers 2025 files, so it did validate the new file.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `c9868c4 2025-12: add rows`, following the repo's month-first message format.

Before committing I ran `scripts/check.sh` and it passed. The script only checks files for the year set in `scripts/check.conf`. That's currently 2025, so the new file was included.

The original file is still in `inbox/`, since I copied it rather than moving it. Tell me if you want it deleted.
